MCC Sandbox MK includes Advanced Rappelling MK (addons\ARMK_AdvancedRappelling.pbo) - a corrected, MODIFIED version of
Advanced Rappelling by Seth Duda ([SA] Duda):
https://github.com/sethduda/AdvancedRappelling - http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=713709341
Its corrections are marked "(MK)" in that addon's config.cpp and functions\fn_advancedRappellingInit.sqf. The same
file is available on its own as the mod "Advanced Rappelling MK".
MCC MK's rope pickups also use code from Advanced Pickup Rope by Dash
(https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1667745333), in its STABO adaptation.
